source_version: NEJM 392;22 (June 12, 2025) main text pages 2237-2241; protocol final version 2025-03-11, FDA IND 31438

scale.precision_class: printed average masses carry 0.01 Da granularity; packet integers are printed*1e6 micro-Dalton, exact at the boundary

mass_ratio.allocation_basis: mass allocation uses the clinical-batch MEASURED ratio 1.1 (UPLC): gRNA share 11/21, mRNA share 10/21 of the dose-1 total RNA mass

residue_table.reference: Joyner JC, Cowan JA. Analysis of RNA cleavage by MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry. Nucleic Acids Res. 2013;41(6):e78. Table 1.

modification_table.reference: Pourshahian S, McCarthy SM. Therapeutic Oligonucleotides, Impurities, Degradants, and their Characterization by Mass Spectrometry. Mass Spectrom Rev. 2021;40(2):75-109. Table 2. doi:10.1002/mas.21620

avogadro.reference: BIPM, The International System of Units (SI Brochure), 9th edition; SI defining constants.

q_ratio_target.text: The targeted ratio of gRNA to mRNA is 1:1 by weight

q_batch_measured.text: The clinical batch of the drug product had an average hydrodynamic diameter of 73 nm with a polydispersity index of 0.07 as determined by dynamic light scattering, 97% total mRNA encapsulation by the RiboGreen fluorescence assay, and a gRNA/mRNA ratio of 1.1 as measured by ultra-performance liquid chromatography (UPLC)-based determinations

q_cap_polya.text: The mRNA drug substance (known as abengcemeran) comprised the 5′ cap, the 5′ untranslated region (UTR), the ABE coding sequence, the 3′ UTR, and the 3′ polyadenylate tail; it was manufactured by Aldevron using proprietary methods

computed.end_group_note: gRNA end-group chemistry has no public direction; no direction or magnitude is claimed, only the typed residual

mrna_cap_mass.detail: Cap-1 mass is named (Figure S1) but no numeric value is public

poly_a_tail_length.detail: no poly(A) tail length number exists in the public package; the actual mRNA molar mass therefore has no public upper structure and actual moles have no payable positive lower bound

mrna_actual_moles_lower_bound.detail: consequence of the unbounded poly(A) tail length

grna_end_group_adjustment.detail: direction unknown; residue-sum value retained as exact
